reason: A DSH Web interface plugin that adds a configurable bottom status bar for conversation, session, token, performance, host-resource, and clock metrics, with extensibility for other plugins.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH Web 添加可配置的底部状态栏，用于显示会话、令牌、生成性能、主机资源和时钟等信息。
summaries.en: Adds a configurable bottom status bar to DSH Web for displaying session, token, generation-performance, host-resource, and clock information.

capabilities: Renders a configurable bottom status bar in the DSH Web interface
Displays conversation, session, token, generation-rate, CPU, memory, and clock metrics
Reads local host CPU and memory usage
Exposes local HTTP endpoints for status snapshots and configuration
Provides an API for other plugins to register status items and data sources
